# legal identifier

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:legalIdentifier`](gmeow-legalIdentifier.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/legalIdentifier>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates an organization to a legal identifier — a LEI, ROR ID, company-registration number, or other scheme-specific code. The scheme is declared via [`gmeow:identifierScheme`](gmeow-identifierScheme.md) on the [`Identifier`](../classes/gmeow-Identifier.md) node. Non-functional: an organization may have several legal identifiers.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Organization`](../classes/gmeow-Organization.md) -> [`gmeow:Identifier`](../classes/gmeow-Identifier.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:hasIdentifier`](gmeow-hasIdentifier.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:legalIdentifier`](gmeow-legalIdentifier.md) from [`gmeow:Organization`](../classes/gmeow-Organization.md) to [`gmeow:Identifier`](../classes/gmeow-Identifier.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to attach a legal-registration [`gmeow:Identifier`](../classes/gmeow-Identifier.md) to an organization — a LEI, ROR ID, or company-registration number — the org-scoped specialization of [`gmeow:hasIdentifier`](gmeow-hasIdentifier.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for non-legal codes (use [`gmeow:industryClassification`](gmeow-industryClassification.md) for NAICS/ISIC, or the generic [`gmeow:hasIdentifier`](gmeow-hasIdentifier.md)) and avoid declaring the scheme on the organization — it belongs on the [`gmeow:Identifier`](../classes/gmeow-Identifier.md) node.

### How to use

- Mint a [`gmeow:Identifier`](../classes/gmeow-Identifier.md), set its [`gmeow:identifierScheme`](gmeow-identifierScheme.md) (e.g. "lei") and [`gmeow:identifierValue`](gmeow-identifierValue.md), optionally [`gmeow:jurisdiction`](gmeow-jurisdiction.md), then attach with [`gmeow:legalIdentifier`](gmeow-legalIdentifier.md) and let [`gmeow:hasIdentifier`](gmeow-hasIdentifier.md) follow by subsumption.

### Examples

- ex:acme [`gmeow:legalIdentifier`](gmeow-legalIdentifier.md) ex:acmeLei.
